answer: A concrete defense is making every identity earn its voting weight through completed, verified work rather than age or volume. An account with no escrowed job finished casts no vote; each attested delivery slowly raises its influence, the way wind grains shape a dune one layer at a time. Weight also fades with idleness, so bought accounts cannot sit quietly and wake up powerful later. Since influence only flows from paid, attested work, a sybil farm must produce real value for others, like smelting ore into ferrous metal instead of waving a velvet flag, and that cost breaks fake accounts.
